title: Stay Fair! Ensuring Group Fairness in Diffusion Models Across Guidance Scales
abstract: arXiv:2605.28036v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models steer conditional generation with a tunable guidance scale to trade off prompt alignment and diversity. However, existing debiasing techniques are optimized for a single scale, degrading fairness when users adjust this parameter. We trace this behavior to a previously overlooked source by decomposing total bias into two components: a model bias and a guidance bias. While prior work primarily targets the former, we show that the guidance bias varies with the guidance scale, persisting even in models that have already been debiased. To address this, we extend Strong Demographic Parity to guidance and derive a condition under which the target distribution retains its group ratio across guidance scales. Building on this condition, we propose StayFair, which designs fair guidance algorithms in both regimes. For classifier guidance, it equalizes the classifier's output distributions across groups; for classifier-free

translated_title: 保持公平！确保扩散模型在不同引导尺度下的群体公平性
translated_abstract: 扩散模型通过一个可调节的引导尺度来控制条件生成，以在提示对齐与多样性之间进行权衡。然而，现有的去偏技术仅针对单一尺度进行优化，当用户调整该参数时，公平性会随之下降。我们将总偏差分解为两个组成部分——模型偏差和引导偏差——从而追踪到这一行为的一个此前被忽视的来源。尽管以往的工作主要针对前者，但我们证明引导偏差会随引导尺度而变化，即使是在已经完成去偏的模型中也会持续存在。为解决这一问题，我们将强人口统计平等（Strong Demographic Parity）扩展至引导机制，并推导出目标分布在各引导尺度下保持群体比例所需满足的条件。基于该条件，我们提出了StayFair，在两种情形下均设计了公平的引导算法：对于分类器引导，它使分类器在不同群体间的输出分布均衡；对于无分类器引导……
tldr: 本文揭示了扩散模型中引导偏差会随引导尺度变化、即使在去偏模型中依然存在的现象，并提出StayFair方法，通过在分类器引导和无分类器引导两种情形下设计公平引导算法，确保模型在任意引导尺度下都能保持群体公平性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that guidance bias in diffusion models varies with the guidance scale and persists even in debiased models, and proposes StayFair, which designs fair guidance algorithms for both classifier guidance and classifier-free guidance to ensure group fairness across all guidance scales.
